title: Multidimensionality of Legal Singularity: Parametric Analysis and the Autonomous Levels of AI Legal Reasoning
reasoning: The paper examines the ethical and legal implications of the 'Legal Singularity,' specifically focusing on justice, fairness, and equity. It discusses the potential for AI systems to institutionalize social bias and evaluates the 'Law Triad' which includes justice as a core normative principle alongside legal certainty.
